channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
item.description: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

item.title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
item.description: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

item.title: Three college students face federal charges over alleged threats against Trump ahead of campus rally
item.description: Three University of South Alabama students face federal charges over alleged social media threats against President Donald Trump ahead of his rally on campus in Mobile.

item.title: Trump says he will attend Alabama vs Georgia college football game at Bryant-Denny Stadium
item.description: Donald Trump announced at a Mobile rally that he plans to attend the No. 7 Alabama vs. No. 2 Georgia showdown at Bryant-Denny Stadium on Oct. 10.

item.title: Tennessee fans drank $1.3 million worth of alcohol before, during Texas game attended by president
item.description: Tennessee sold 95,000 units of alcohol and generated $1.3 million during Trump's visit to Knoxville, prompting a season-long happy hour at Neyland Stadium

item.title: Miami Heat tease release of new 'Vice City' jerseys on the night before 'Grand Theft Auto VI' release
item.description: "Grand Theft Auto VI" gets an unprecedented sports tie-in as the Miami Heat debut reimagined "Vice City" jerseys against the Milwaukee Bucks.

item.title: Body-cam footage shows moment Luigi Mangione was arrested at a McDonald’s
item.description: Newly released video records his arrest in Pennsylvania in connection with the shooting of health care executive Brian Thompson.

item.title: Governor slams district attorney, Cornell police on handling of rape allegations
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul (D) also called on legislators to tighten a law limiting the ability to prosecute sexual assault if a victim voluntarily became intoxicated.

item.title: Another disappointing jobs report suggests more challenges for Trump, GOP
item.description: The unemployment rate ticked up to 4.2 percent while wages continued to lag behind inflation in the government’s final jobs report before the Nov. 3 midterm election.

item.title: Renée Good’s family sues Trump officials, saying death was ‘not an accident’
item.description: The death of the mother of three sparked protests and scrutiny over how federal officers are using force against both immigrants and protesters.

item.title: Supreme Court to scrutinize ICE’s mandatory detention policy for immigrants
item.description: The case, one of the first the court has accepted since its summer recess ended, promises to be among the most consequential of the term that begins next week.

item.title: Trump revisits the scene of his political ascent as Republicans struggle
item.description: A month before the midterms, the president is returning to Alabama and other places where his movement remains strongest.

item.title: Trump heads back to Texas on Wednesday as GOP fights to keep state red
item.description: Texas, long a safe Republican state, has emerged as a top battleground in midterm races up and down the ballot — but especially in the U.S. Senate race.

item.title: DOJ probe into Trump foes sees another prominent departure
item.description: Kurt Olsen, who previously worked as Trump’s election security czar, resigned from the “grand conspiracy” investigation on Monday.

item.title: Ex-congressman and Rubio ally gets 10 years for secret Venezuela lobbying
item.description: Former congressman David Rivera (R-Florida) maintained that, despite a $50 million lobbying contract from Venezuela’s government, he advocated for the removal of President Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Top Senate GOP-aligned super PAC pauses N.C. spending, in sign of deepening woes
item.description: The Senate Leadership Fund’s pulling money from North Carolina is the latest signal the Republican Party is giving up hope of holding that Senate seat.

item.title: Talarico, Paxton launch dueling ads amid heated Senate race in Texas
item.description: Both contenders are airing spots intended to address perceived vulnerabilities.

item.title: How Trump keeps embracing AI
item.description: And what else happened this week under his administration.

item.title: Midterm polls that caught our eye this week show more good news for Democrats
item.description: Polls show close contests in competitive Senate races and rare independent polling in Virginia congressional races.

item.title: Trump embarks on rally blitz, hoping to energize GOP voters
item.description: Trump’s low standing with voters limits the places he can most effectively campaign. Advisers hope he can energize GOP voters.
